signature: TArray<AFortPlayerController*> GetAllFortPlayerControllers(const UObject* WorldContextObject, bool bIncludeNonSpectators, bool bIncludeSpectators)

callees.0x141eefea0: helper: walks the world's player controllers; keeps AFortPlayerController instances, split into FortPlayerControllerSpectating and the rest by the two bool gates

notes: Gate order: the native helper receives (world, non-spectator gate, spectator gate). The inventory lists the parameters in reverse declaration order, so the first Bool in bytecode order is bIncludeNonSpectators. The iterator is the engine player-controller list (UWorld::GetPlayerControllerIterator is an equivalent API).
